uploadTraces.question: What file formats are supported?
uploadTraces.answer: GeneFlow supports: AB1 (.ab1) - Applied Biosystems chromatogram files with full quality data. SCF (.scf) - Standard Chromatogram Format. FASTQ (.fastq, .fq) - Sequences with quality scores. FASTA (.fasta, .fa) - Sequence-only files. Maximum file size is 50MB per trace.

availablePipelines.question: What pipeline steps are available?
availablePipelines.answer: Pipelines chain analysis steps that run on a trace: Quality (per-base quality scoring), Trimming (low-quality end removal), Heterozygote (double-peak detection), Motif (search a DNA motif, optionally on the reverse complement), Translation (codon translation in a chosen frame), ORF (open reading frame detection), and Restriction (restriction-enzyme site search). Steps execute in order; progress is streamed in real time.

inviteTeam.question: What are the different team roles?
inviteTeam.answer: Owner - Full control, can transfer ownership (one per study). Admin - Manage members, change study settings and status. Editor - Create and edit traces and alignments. Viewer - Read-only access to study data. Invitations are sent by email and must be accepted to join.

exportResults.question: What are study statuses?
exportResults.answer: Studies progress through: Draft - Initial setup, not visible. Active - Work in progress. Completed - Research finished. Published - Publicly visible in Discover. Archived - Hidden but preserved. Only the Owner or Admin can change status.

dataProtection.question: How do I secure my account?
dataProtection.answer: Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) using TOTP with apps like Google Authenticator or Authy. You can also sign in with Google or GitHub OAuth. Sessions expire after inactivity and can be managed in Settings > Security.

fileFormats.question: How does trace processing work?
fileFormats.answer: After upload, traces go through: Uploaded - File received. Validating - Format and integrity check. Processing - Quality analysis and base calling. Processed - Ready for use. Failed traces can be retried. Quality metrics include average quality score, Q20/Q30 percentages, GC content, and trimmed length.
